$comment: schema_version 1.0.0; tracks design/spec/features/NF-002-010-signed-eval-cards.md (NF-002) and ADR-0099. A signed, content-addressed evaluator card stored as an Asset-Registry asset (asset_type: eval-card). eval_card_digest = sha256 over the canonical-JSON bytes of the card EXCLUDING the signature block. Planned/experimental.
title: EvalCard
description: The reproducibility key for an evidence-grade Score: pins the exact evaluator (judge model, prompt version, rubric, dataset version, human-agreement calibration) that produced a score, and carries an Ed25519 signature so the binding is tamper-evident.

source.description: Evaluator kind. judge cards MUST also carry judge_model/prompt_version/rubric/dataset_version/calibration.

endpoint_ref.description: Reference to a configurable private endpoint (e.g. env:NOVA_JUDGE_ENDPOINT). No hardcoded external URL (ADR-0024).
